claim: The sample uses a demo-only storage namespace; reset and exit do not change real data.
where: landing action, demo banner, README, demo.md
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed real sentinels, enter ?demo=1, replay, reset, and compare all non-demo keys

claim: The sample opens without installing the extension and immediately shows a checkout dialog with four ordered events.
where: landing action, demo page metadata, README
sandbox: fresh regular browser context; click the landing sample action and assert the canonical demo route, checkout dialog, four events, and no extension runtime

claim: Reset demo restores the original four-event sample.
sandbox: fresh demo; mutate replay state, reset, and compare the complete stored seed with its original value

claim: The sample exports one HTML trace with keyboard actions, focus, page details, and nearby control snapshots.
where: landing, demo export preview, README, catalog description
sandbox: fresh demo; download the generated file and inspect its complete content

claim: Trace events stay in the order they happened.
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; compare visible and serialized event order and timestamps

claim: Shift+Tab moves focus behind the sample dialog and Escape restores it to the opener.
sandbox: fresh lab page; operate the real dialog with the keyboard and assert focus after each key

claim: Recording starts only on request and shows a toolbar badge and recorder bar.
sandbox: built extension source; assert the start-message boundary and both indicator paths

claim: Typed characters become Character while navigation keys remain identifiable.
where: landing, popup, privacy, README, catalog description
sandbox: fixed keyboard sequence through the production key-label function

claim: Sensitive field values are excluded from structured trace data and optional screenshots.
sandbox: visible ARIA-labelled password fixture; mask, capture JPEG, build trace, and inspect pixels and text

claim: Screenshots start off and, when enabled, use visible-tab capture with a 12-image cap.
sandbox: built popup and background; assert unchecked default, visible-tab API, cap, and no desktop capture

claim: Exported trace files open without a network connection.
sandbox: fresh offline browser context; render generated trace and assert fields with zero requests

claim: Visited site pages remain available offline.
sandbox: fresh browser; prime service worker, go offline, reload landing, and assert the main heading

claim: The extension stores traces in browser storage and has no account, analytics, tracker, API, or upload service.
sandbox: capture the full demo request set and scan extension runtime entrypoints for remote transfer code

claim: Nearby control snapshots contain selected DOM details, not a browser or operating-system accessibility tree.
where: landing, demo, terms, README, exported file
sandbox: fresh demo and generated export; assert the exact scope label and limitation

claim: The manifest requests activeTab, scripting, storage, and downloads, with no host permissions.
sandbox: clean production build; parse manifest and compare the exact permission set

claim: Version 1 is packaged for Chromium browsers.
sandbox: clean production build; parse the emitted Chromium MV3 manifest, action, and service worker

claim: The production build creates the unpacked extension, packaged ZIP, deployable site, and public download.
sandbox: clean production build; assert all four artifacts exist and are non-empty

claim: The product is free and its source uses the MIT License.
sandbox: fresh site and repository; assert visible free fact, MIT grant, and no billing integration

claim: The hero is generated original imagery and the interface mark is hand-authored for this product.
sandbox: clean repository; assert source artwork, prompt record, authored SVG, and provenance section
